design: One fresh implementation per condition, identical requirements and dependency versions, separate directories, virtual environments and CLI sessions outside the repository.
treatment: Only sharp-frames-development is installed as a project skill; the common task is prefixed with its explicit Claude Code invocation.
control: No Sharp Frames project or user skill is exposed. Host bundled skills remain available equally in both conditions.
common_input: REQUIREMENTS.md and flattened pinned requirements.txt; no starter implementation, previous examples, intended architecture or grader.
permission_mode: acceptEdits with the listed tools preapproved for the requested local implementation and tests
configuration: project setting source only, explicit project settings, no MCP, no Chrome, no persisted/resumed session, no model override
stopping: One generation per condition. Do not repair, prompt with grader failures, reroll or select a better candidate after viewing outcomes. Setup failures before generation are recorded separately.
primary: Frozen external HTTP contract groups against the submitted entry point, new disposable DB and server process for each test; no internal module or table-name assumptions.
secondary: Actual file trees, candidate self-tests and evidence of work; architecture and file counts are descriptive and not quality scores.
preflight: Confirmed identical default model metadata, package versions and built-in skill lists, and treatment-only Sharp Frames visibility. Preflight sessions do not continue into implementation sessions.
limitations: one synthetic task, one generation per condition; no statistical or causal productivity claim
same operating system, runtime installation, authenticated provider account and package cache
directory/context/configuration isolation, not separate machines, OS users or an adversarial file-access sandbox
native and shell tool calls are audited for cross-workspace or previous-example reads; this audit is not tamper-proof OS enforcement
headless CLI with preapproved editing/test tools, not an interactive browser or separate-user onboarding trial
scope excludes production authentication providers, deployment and performance measurement
